messages:
tara.nguyen: @channel heads-up — the inference-route-5xx-rate alert started firing ~every minute on canary since 05:10 UTC. Anyone have quick pointers where to check traces/logs? Thinking we might mute briefly while we investigate. :wave:
ben_smith: saw it too. looks correlated with rollout to dedicated-pool-2. grafana dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd/inference-routes?var-route=inference-route
rachel: traces are in Tempo under service=inference-proxy, trace id will appear in the 5xx logs. Kibana query: `request.path:/v1/generate AND status:5*` time range last 30m.
tara.nguyen: thanks — do we have an ops runbook for temporary mutes? don't want to blindside alerts during rollout.
sre-bot: Deploy 1692 to canary started at 05:05 UTC — note: auto-rollback enabled. :robot_face: (reaction)
ben_smith: opsctl alert mute --alert inference-route-5xx-rate --until 2026-03-17T06:10:00Z --reason "canary rollout noisy 5xx" — i'd do 1 hour. will also tag canary=true to suppress.
rachel: proposed long-term: increase threshold from 0.5% -> 1.5% for canary stage, or scope alert to production-only. also add grouping by route to avoid noisy retry-heavy routes.
tara.nguyen: can someone run the mute? i don't have perms. I can collect traces and paste a couple ids here after i dig.
ben_smith: running mute now. will post the command output.
ben_smith: `OK: muted inference-route-5xx-rate until 2026-03-17T06:10:00Z (id=muteb5f9)`
tara.nguyen: thanks — i'll attach two trace ids in a min. initial quick look shows increased backend connection resets in canary node pool.
rachel: if connection resets, check node pool SG and egress limits. also good to flag infra to check bursting on dedicated-pool-2.
tara.nguyen: filing a short follow-up in eng-infra. will update here with root cause and if we need permanent threshold change. :thumbsup:
ben_smith: sgtm. leaving note in the alert ticket to revisit thresholds post-rollout.
